reviews.title: TERRIBLE
reviews.text: The app is terrible. They changed it without giving users any notice. I paid for something completely different from what they offer now. The customer service is awful; they can take weeks to reply to a single message. The AI they added can’t even carry on a natural conversation. It’s awful.

reviews.title: New update is awful
reviews.text: I just updated and regret it so much. The new design update is beyond frustrating and makes having the app entirely pointless. You all removed so much visibility on the main page to see my lessons and have now hidden things behind clouds. I can’t redo lessons or skip around. And the page where I could choose to work on grammar, speaking etc was completely removed. The experience is so much worse and it’s really frustrating because it was so helpful. If the investment went into the AI feature you’ve lost the plot by taking away what made the app valuable. I wish I could roll it back to the previous version because now it’s an absolute waste of time and money.

reviews.title: Charged but can’t access
reviews.text: I was charged for a year worth subscription, but unable to use the app. Promova says they can’t give me a refund and Apple won’t give me a refund either.

reviews.title: Purchased and Paid for one Year but can‘t access everything why?
reviews.text: I wonder why the app makes you pay 130$ if you can‘t see all the lessons you did before. What the point if i can‘t see the previous lessons if i wan’t to do it again to memorize it? I contacted the support many times because my subscription didn’t work after the update. That also takes them days and weeks to fix it or answer me. The AI support keeps repeating the same and can’t really help you either. I’m not happy about it. So i basically paid for the few lessons i can do a day and then they disappear anyways and i don’t really have access to them. I do new ones and they disappear again. Thanks for nothing i don’t recommend.

reviews.text: I wish there was a way to slow the cadence down a bit. It’s very difficult to “shadow” at such a fast pace as a beginner.

reviews.title: Not happy with updates
reviews.text: I have chosen this app specifically for ability to revisit the units, because I need to be able to go through material multiple times to really learn it. I paid for family membership of the previous version of the app (over $100). Now I am deeply unhappy with design and trying to get my refund. Responses from customers service (humans, not AI) take several days. I am hoping they will refund me, because new setup is exactly why I decided not to sign up with other apps.

reviews.title: Billed for free trial and content not as advertised
reviews.text: I signed up for a free monthly trial and was billed £19.99! The ad that made me click on the app featured videos which you talked along with to master complex French. I couldn’t find this in the app and the lessons just seemed simple and annoying. Thankfully Apple refunded the £19.99 and I’ve deleted the app.

reviews.title: Limited for Italian
reviews.text: I was excited to get this app as I was impressed with the trial units. But it barely has anything on it for Italian - the advanced course literally has 3 sections. And the promised AI tutor never materialised. Don’t waste your money

reviews.text: This application is a master class in onboarding screens.  Took about three minutes before I even saw anything related to language learning. There are better resources don't waste your time or money.

reviews.title: Can’t understand me
reviews.text:
When I speak in Spanish the app takes the words I say if there is an English equivalent and puts that instead. For example, I said “si” so they wrote “see”. There is no way to fix what you say in the chat when AI gets it wrong. Super frustrating. 

Also why are we talking about soccer? Is it because of the World Cup? If I didn’t already know about soccer in English I would have been completely lost. Maybe start with food, shopping, watching tv, social media. Something everyone does on a regular basis not a niche topic.

reviews.title: Confused or False advertising?
reviews.text: I downloaded the app for Korean. It shows you the dialogue on the ad but when you do the modules, you don’t see the dialogue or text practices. I am somewhere past beginner level and just about intermediate, but the app is limited to what they say “intermediate” but I would say it’s pretty beginner level vocabulary and grammar. At least advertise what you offer just be fair please 😭.

reviews.title: Inadequate coding, poor execution
reviews.text: Too many bugs and inadequate checking of coding. This app frequently locks you into an ad with no escape other than buying, or your lesson work is lost. The ‘spoken’ exercises spell-check what you say into English, losing the language you spoke, and does the same with written exercises. The developers need to do a lot of back-office work. I deleted after 3 days.

reviews.title: These lessons make no sense
reviews.text: I’ve been using Duolingo to learn French for a while, but thought I’d check this out to improve my speech. I’m intermediate level, but the first “lesson” assumed I was advanced because I didn’t understand any of it. So I chose Beginner level to see how it would proceed, and the first “lesson” drilled me on a bunch of soccer/football equipment and terminology. I doubt that the first words a beginner wants to learn are things like shin guards, cleats, jerseys, and stadiums. Seriously, this app is so awful and buggy!

reviews.title: Made no sense!
reviews.text: So started teaching me in a way I liked except I started learning soccer terms… which likely won’t help me in France and after feeling good about the few French soccer words AI chats starts asking me about the weather in the lesson. In full sentences using none of the vocabulary it taught me in the first lesson and wanting me to respond in French sentences. Super weird. I will canceling my free trial before I get charged!

reviews.title: Not good - deleted
reviews.text: It’s annoying that I’ve wasted time on this app, which I have now deleted.  After 2 days, I didn’t see anything original (the AI is coming soon apparently) except for basic errors (e.g. ‘maglio’ instead of ’meglio’) that you wouldn’t expect to see these days, especially considering the near-£90 annual subscription fee.  The app is nothing like the ad you may have seen on Instagram btw.

reviews.title: Wish I could get a refund

reviews.title: Don’t ever give them your CC info
reviews.text:
I disputed a $49.99 charge from Promova for a subscription that I canceled on the same day it was charged.

I did not intend to continue the subscription beyond the initial period, and I canceled immediately after realizing the renewal. I have not used the service after canceling.

I attempted to contact the company multiple times by email and phone to request a refund, but I have received no response.

Because the subscription was canceled right away and the service was not used, I believe this charge is unfair and should be refunded but they never refunded and responded of my request😡 please be careful with these people

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text:
Too basic and far too much English, and the pictures to accompany the words were not clear as to what they meant, when I’m trying to learn a language I expect clear photos and better explanations. Bought a 6 month plan and dearly regret it. 
Edit client services contacted me and I was refunded. No doubt that they are a good company and care about their users. Thank you.

reviews.title: Could have been better

I was very excited to try this app until I found out there was no Russian included. I have a Russian background so therefore I unfortunately cannot use this app to help my practice.

reviews.title: Nice for practicing
reviews.text: The only thing I have to say is that all the good stuff they showed us on the Ads are not actually on the plan so you have to pay additional money for those … like learning with video of your favorite series.

reviews.title: Very low-quality language  learning app
reviews.text: Overpriced and false advertising, the Facebook ad that took me to the app showed something completely different. Low quality and wayyy overpriced for what it offers.

reviews.title: Annoyingly limited content
reviews.text: I signed up for Portuguese, and paid $60 for six months to get ready for my trip to Portugal. It took me less than a week to finish all the lessons that were available at 10 minutes or so a day. There are only four units, and there seems to be no way to progress from beginner to any other level. This was a waste of money. I want my $60 back.

reviews.title: Free, ads are a must to get lesson
reviews.text: I understand this model I would much rather they request an ad per unit rather than give you one lesson and then force you to a paywall if you want to learn more on this app. But I also find it kind of inconvenient to always need to watch an ad to continue. It’s already kind of tough to find the time while in college to take the time to go onto a learning app. When already needing to study elsewhere for the 7 some classes. That’s why I find it a two out of five star.

reviews.title: Teaching should not business
reviews.text:
For best service in teaching is not to take just money, it’s about make things to understandable. I saw many individuals courses have different packages. I knew that the hard work behind this but I don’t see anything better than free application provides. But here it’s more expensive than others. 
Make it good deal with affordable budget, and more features is needed. Here it’s look like I am in school again.

reviews.title: Utterly incompetent customer service
reviews.text: I did this course for two pay cycles but decided it was far too expensive at £50/quarter.  Went to cancel and they offered another quarter at £4.  Fair enough, I accepted.  What of course then happens? They charge me full renewal price to my card.  Outraged I contacted support who promised me a refund within 10 days.  A month later I’m disgusted to see no refund has been made, and to add insult to injury I discover they actually charged me £60 not £50 for the renewal! After yet another discussion with customer “service” they’ve finally refunded me, but this time the whole amount and they’ve now cancelled my account completely and immediately.  All I ever asked is for this wretched company to do what they originally promised and charge me the offer price of £4 for the current quarter.  This is clearly beyond their wit and I am no longer remotely interested in their services, so I will close by advising anyone who doesn’t want their credit card pillaged to steer well clear

reviews.title: Ignore their customers whilst taking their money
reviews.text: I purchased a membership but the membership does not show on my account. I have sent emails and tried to use their contact bot but they do not answer. Seem very happy to take money but not happy to provide the service you have paid for
